title: Need for Speed Heat
provenance: Reported by Akuip (highball#788, 2026-11-24), Apple M1 Pro, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r31, DXVK: the Steam copy starts and plays, but lags and stutters even at very low settings. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Ghost Games' 2019 racer, a DirectX 11 game here. Reported playable but stuttering on an M1 Pro through DXVK and MoltenVK on the Wine 11 engine r31.

knownIssues.symptom: Lags and stutters even at very low settings (M1 Pro, Wine 11 r31, DXVK, highball#788). The player then tried every in-game setting and it still lags while driving (highball#788, 2026-11-25)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. The environment ran DXVK, which goes through MoltenVK, rather than DXMT, Highball's default for DirectX 11
knownIssues.fix: untested: set the game's Graphics mode to DXMT on its page
